notes: Predeployment review candidate for the accepted Sepolia prototype; not deployment approval. LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol has no constructor arguments. AgentArcade in src/AgentArcade.sol is the sole application contract. Its sponsor and fee recipient both resolve exclusively through policy $owner. No initialization calls are required. VRF configuration uses the Sepolia Chainlink VRF v2.5 coordinator and 500 gwei key hash documented at https://docs.chain.link/vrf/v2-5/supported-networks#ethereum-sepolia-testnet, with 150000 callback gas, 3 confirmations and native ETH billing (ABI bool 1). UNRESOLVED BLOCKING CONSTRUCTOR FINDING: subscription ID 7777 is the test fixture, and getSubscription(7777) on the configured Sepolia coordinator reverts with InvalidSubscription() (0x1f6a65b6) at block 11796451; the LINK() control succeeds at that block. No authorized replacement subscription ID was supplied. Admission and deployment must not proceed with these constructor inputs. Replace constructorArgs[4] with an authorized, funded Sepolia subscription and independently review its owner, native ETH billing and resulting immutable inputs. Register the deployed arcade as a consumer before creating any epoch: an invalid subscription prevents draws and leaves funded open-epoch backing unsweepable. Accepted draws have no cancellation or reroll and provider failure can stall the game. The accepted token mints 1,000,000 WFD (10^24 minor units), matching the approved brief. README.md rejects default policy v5 and requires a compatible service policy allocating 100% to enrolled Identity MD NFT claims, with no contributor rewards or automatic liquidity allocation. Service policy compatibility, enrollment coverage, finalized ownership evidence, deterministic rounding and cross-chain contract-wallet recipients remain to be verified by services. The pool configuration is native ETH, fee 3000, tick spacing 60, no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 (2^96), with effective policy pricing handled by services. No verified POOL4 implementation or compatible deployment evidence is present in the accepted tree; this pool description does not establish compliance with that requirement. The factory supplies the LP and MerkleDistributor, so neither is an application entry. Liquidity and arcade prizes require voluntary funding separate from claim reserves; this manifest does not authorize reserve diversion or additional funding. Policy, signed artifact linkage, source publication, attestation, admission, deployment and frontend publication belong to subsequent services; no successful service outcome is asserted here. These notes record unresolved findings and do not override constructor values, policy or authorization.
